dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.text: Huh, who are you? Are you just here to watch my master's humiliation?

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.text: I'm a disciple of the Meikyou Shisui Art. My master's name is Domon.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.text: My master used to be a great swordsman and a Vision-wielder. He will become the best in the world one day!

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.text: However, my master has been very out of sorts after losing his Vision due to the Vision Hunt Decree. I don't know what to do...

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.text: My parents were murdered by pirates when I was little, and I was almost killed as well. If it hadn't been for my master, I would have been dead a long time ago.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.text: I will never find a way to repay him fully. Now that he's in trouble, I have to find a way to help him get back on his feet...

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.text: No, I can't give up yet. I need to figure this out somehow...

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.text: It's you, Traveler. Long time no see!

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.text: Thanks to you and Guuji Yae, my master has returned to normal again. He has been teaching us swordsmanship every day, and there's hope in his eyes again.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.text: As his disciples, we shall also work harder to fulfill our goal of becoming the greatest swordsmen.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.text: Bye! I should be getting back to practice, at any rate.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.text: Yup! With your encouragement, I'll definitely become strong!

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.text: That reminds me. Recently, when I was training in the dojo, I discovered a foreign-looking weapon. Did my master study it to hone his martial arts...?

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.text: Even if we kept it here, not many people will know how to use it. If that's the case, how about I give it to you? You came from another lands, so I think you'll be able to draw out this sword's true potential.
